description: Make your reports beautiful with a PowerPoint-style banner that filters by category Process Flow Diagram represents your process, progress or phases as a customisable sequence of interlocking arrows, which filter or highlight on click, and can be coloured in multiple ways to add a touch of class to your Power BI reports. Why choose Viz Data for Power BI We strive to make beautiful and highly functional custom visuals that mimic the standard offering from Microsoft, so we support Tooltips, Edit Interactions highlighting and filtering, data-driven sorting and colouring. We think Power BI reports have the potential to look as good as a PowerPoint presentation or website, while retaining a great deal more functionality. Key Features and Benefits ⚡Engaging & Intuitive Design: Seamlessly blend the polish of web design and presentations into your Power BI reports with beautiful interlocking arrows. ⚡Free in unsupported environments: We believe the web is Power BI's superpower, so in cases where we cannot check user licenses (e.g., Publish to Web), we skip license checks altogether. (This is subject to change.) ⚡Cross-Filtering: Users can filter or highlight other visuals by clicking on an arrow, using Edit Interactions to set the click behavior they want. ⚡Data-Driven Coloring: Highlight the flow of a process with color gradients, or draw attention to…
